subject.title: feat(mattermost): auto-engage on replies to the bot's own thread

question: Should Mattermost reply-to-bot thread-root engagement ship on by default, without a new config option, after live proof or an explicit proof waiver?
rationale: The implementation fits the Mattermost plugin boundary, but it changes when existing requireMention/onchar rooms deliver agent replies and the PR has a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Accept Default-On Parity With Proof Or Waiver
options.body: Treat bot-authored Mattermost thread roots as addressed by default, matching sibling channels, and merge after a live roundtrip is captured or intentionally waived.

options.title: Make Reply-To-Bot Opt-In
options.body: Require a Mattermost config or policy choice before existing rooms answer bot-root thread replies without explicit mentions.

options.title: Pause For Broader Thread Policy
options.body: Hold this PR and fold reply-to-bot, participated-thread, and future Mattermost thread mention behavior into a broader owner decision.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-On Parity With Proof Or Waiver
recommendation.body: Treat bot-authored Mattermost thread roots as addressed by default, matching sibling channels, and merge after a live roundtrip is captured or intentionally waived.
